name: Neutralization
description: Reaction between an acid and a base forming water and a salt, usually exothermic with pH change toward 7.

name: Precipitation
description: Reaction between soluble ions in aqueous solution forming an insoluble solid precipitate.

name: Combination / Synthesis
description: Reaction where two or more simple chemical substances combine to form a single more complex product.

name: Decomposition
description: Reaction where a single chemical compound breaks down into two or more simpler products.

name: Single Displacement
description: Reaction where a more reactive element displaces a less reactive element from its compound.

name: Double Displacement
description: Reaction where ions exchange between two reactant compounds in solution.

name: Combustion
description: Exothermic redox reaction between a fuel and an oxidant (usually oxygen gas) producing heat and light.

name: Oxidation-Reduction (Redox)
description: Reaction involving a transfer of electrons between chemical species, changing oxidation states.

name: Gas Evolution
description: Reaction that produces a gaseous substance as one of its products, resulting in effervescence/bubbling.

name: Indicator Color Change
description: Reversible structural/protonation change in an indicator molecule in response to ambient pH changes.

name: Thermal / Endothermic Disruption
description: Reaction driven by thermal energy input or causing significant temperature reduction.

name: Electrochemical / Electrolysis
description: Reaction driven by or producing an electric current, causing oxidation at the anode and reduction at the cathode.
